input_file.description: Input file path; default is stdin.

output_file.description: Output file path; default is stdout.

block_size.description: Block size in bytes with optional suffix (b=512, k=1024, m=1048576); default is 10k.

max_shared_mem.description: Maximum size of shared memory segment; default is 1m.

buffer_blocks.description: Number of blocks for shared memory circular buffer; 0 means auto.

min_fill_pct.description: Only start write when queue is at least this percentage full (0-100); recommended ~75 for tapes.

sleep_usecs.description: Microseconds to sleep after each write; 0 means no sleep.

pad_last_block.description: Pad last block to block size; needed for some tape drives.

summary_on_exit.description: Print total bytes written to stderr on exit.

seek_after_1gb.description: Perform lseek after each GiB written; use with extreme care on character devices.
